testgaps.detail: This approves the exact frozen helper/integration source and retained isolated proof only. New assembled candidate build, real game save/award/generation invariance, game retry/import/restart/physical-edit regressions and focused human four-direction tilt/reflection feedback remain parent-owned acceptance gates. Existing partial/user passes remain intact. No human perceptibility, task closure, publication or further phase is approved.

Actual client-event/layout-scale parity is proven at 1280x720,1600x900,2560x1080. These are resolution/layout-scale changes, not a retained multi-monitor/Windows per-monitor DPI transition matrix. Do not describe them as exhaustive OS DPI coverage.

Leaving the fitted surface for other UI is exercised. A retained actual WM_MOUSELEAVE/cross-window departure and reentry sequence is absent. The MouseLeaveWindow branch and following Repaint behavior are statically reviewed but not independently exercised here; no demonstrated runtime defect is asserted.

Retained source/stage/after pins match the final3 source, and the driver checks the player executable hash. These runners do not retain a complete immutable compiled payload membership/hash pin (managed assembly, resources.assets and every player file), and normal/fallback runs share a mutable stage player path. The executable alone is not proof of exact Unity embedded payload bytes. Native outcomes and source provenance are admitted as isolated behavioral evidence, not immutable packaged-candidate attestation.

GPU geometry/mask classification samples every second framebuffer pixel; CPU/GPU source-color landmarks have documented footprint/color tolerance. Independent reanalysis also samples every second pixel and excludes a separately disclosed three-source-texel mask-transition footprint. This is not all-pixel OCR/readability or arbitrary same-sized semantic-mask validation. Actual supplied masks/roles pass; null/wrong-size masks are matte.

notes.finding: Both target axes map normalized pointer coordinates to +/-12 degrees, nonfinite/outside input neutralizes targets, and input is clamped without accumulating. Exact exponential response uses double intermediates, a convex no-overshoot interpolation. Invalid/nonpositive delta and running=false leave pose unchanged; finite huge delta settles safely; Reset clears pose and targets. Recompiled and executed exact source independently: 215 assertions, including 200 repeated bounded reversals, not 215 distinct behaviors.

Ry(yaw)*Rx(pitch) basis and normal are orthonormal; inverse ray-plane t=-N.C/(N.D) with C=(0,0,2.4), shared recovered face/mask UV, source alpha and discard produce perspective silhouette/texture. Reflect(-view,N) intersects fixed light plane z=2 with two broad super-Gaussian softboxes. No _Time animation exists; caller clock is sanitized but unused by light. Independent forward/inverse/outward-overscan sampling passed 625 fractional/extreme-aspect cases with maximum UV error 9.592326932761353e-14; sampled minimum camera depth 2.1943599938221703. Not a claim of 625 unique runtime tests.

Independent native-PNG reanalysis passes 45 analytical silhouette frames, 27 same-projection finish/matte pairs, 24 non-neutral surface-UV-binned reflection movements at clock7.25, zero outside-mask/background changes away from explicitly excluded transition footprint, and achromatic added wrapper energy. Eighteen matte same-pose/different-clock decoded images are exact; null/wrong-size masks and extreme clamps exactly equal their matte reference. Author GPU checks additionally cover corners, landmarks, synthetic projected alpha holes and actual deferred material destruction.

Actual selected wrapper front/back chooses its matching mask; holo uses only selected card holo mask; nonholo/backs are matte. Renderer rejects absent/misaligned dimensions or unknown finish to matte, never full-metallic fallback. New shader is Resources.Load-loaded and demonstrably retained in normal native fixture (missing/unsupported controls return false). Draw false uses unchanged 2D path; successful full face returns before old print/finish paint. Owned material disposal is idempotent/permanent and preserves provider textures.

Actual Event.current.mousePosition is read before GUI scale and divided once by layout.scale. Repaint clears/rebuilds the current eligible surface set, reverse paint order picks one original fitted hit rectangle. No historical union; stack-back roles do not include hidden identity; modal inspection excludes all background surfaces and rejected hidden inspection exposes none. Length-prefixed transaction/stage/visible-count/inspection context clears controllers, role/index distinguish surfaces, cache insertion caps32. Returned observation arrays and entries are detached and frame-current in retained native states. Hover targets advance in Update, with existing accepted click rectangles unchanged.

Hover path only samples/targets/renders: no generator/save/award/command/audio calls. Running gates freeze pointer/context/targets/pose/light clock under pause/focus/error/Binder/hidden overlay. Native state comparisons verify exact fingerprints/clock/context/pointer across each admitted freeze. Focus pause request and six explicit button clicks are separate from hover. Serialized opt-in defaults false and old 2D path is preserved. Retained unchanged legacy checks: Phase2=62,Phase3=29,materials=67 with31 PNGs. Fixture has no host/save authority; no fake real-game save invariance claim.

Shader full-face path is clipped against conservative/quiet layout intersection, with original fitted hover/hit authority, away from inspection info/Back, result footer and unrevealed labels. Retained native bounds assertions and inspected integrated screenshots show no demonstrated print/control overpaint. Hint outside art and accepted Skip area equality are proved. Fallback native control has11 checks and2 complete PNGs: real poses vary but old2D pixels remain stable.

Driver enumerates visible windows, calls GetWindowThreadProcessId and selects the launched PID-owned HWND, then PostMessageW WM_MOUSEMOVE. Retained full run reconciles60 moves and6 explicit down/up click pairs (eventCount66),194 passed checks,43 full PNGs. Fixture mailbox contains no pointer/pose setter; pose is read from production controllers and capture reads actual native framebuffer. No global cursor/foreground APIs or fabricated poststates appear in the reviewed path. Historical OS ownership is evidenced by retained records plus reviewed code, not by pretending to re-observe an exited HWND.

Actual no-op motion RED and yaw-only RED fail behavior before GREEN. Corrected geometry RED fails1130 left-silhouette pixels; geometry-only reflection RED yields zero highlight; isolated disposal-leak mutant fails deferred destruction. Initial geometry-red misclassified dark source ink and is not admitted as valid geometric RED. Corrected oracle retains out-of-silhouette detection and positive corner/texture landmark checks; explicit outward raster rounding/offset fixes fractional projection instead of relaxing solid-background/mask exactness. Interrupted reflection-green-v2 and mailbox-sharing failures remain failures, not renamed successes. Integration retained RED assertions cover opt-in/observations/pointer/faces/Binder/overlay/hint/Skip/seams/bounds.

TiltSurfaceChecks resolves isolated SurfaceGpuFixture by assembly string/reflection only, with no compile-time fixture reference; TiltPresentationChecks also depends only on production/Unity. Retained production-compile-final-green has native exit0 and source pins excluding fixture, while final GPU build reports Succeeded errors=0 warnings=0. Original CS0246 raw failure was not present in the scoped surface evidence logs; closure is established by corrected source and retained fixture-free compile, not by inventing an original log. Current mutable stage is not asserted fixture-free. Parent meta adoption record matches exact source hash and byte-equal actual-stage TiltPresentationChecks meta/guid; stale earlier source hash is not used.

The first audit attempt rejected older final2-contract IntegrationFixture.cs hash72ad168500eff552cd9eefa50255940c2454ed03c806e9aba5fb078770012add versus current12e65e3ed57afb3cb56aa7bb04b611d9420de6d06ab723819a77b85578cf1f05. That run is contract-only; its production check/source pins match. Final3 normal and fallback native runs pin the current fixture and production sources exactly. The historical difference is disclosed, not silently represented as current full integration evidence.

Viewed both actual native contact sheets and actual integrated inspection-up,wrapper-1280-right,results-hover screenshots. Opposing horizontal/vertical perspective edges are visible; holo illustration color response shifts, wrapper highlights stay silver, matte/cardback printing remains present. Integrated modal card and results grid do not visibly overpaint controls in those captures. Tiny contact-sheet legal text and subjective strength/smoothness are not established. No blanket human-perceptibility claim.

report.verdict: PASS for the exact frozen helper/surface/shader/passive-pointer integration review; no demonstrated blocking security or logic defect. Nonblocking proof limits remain explicit.
